svg.text: The model never writes SQL. You govern everything through config, descriptions, and RBAC.

text.font-family: Segoe UI Emoji, Segoe UI, Arial

svg.text: Grant each role only the actions it needs — unauthorized calls are denied before any SQL runs.

text.font-family: Segoe UI Emoji, Segoe UI, Arial

svg.text: Server, entity, and field descriptions are how the model picks the right tool (NL2DAB). No descriptions = guessing.

text.font-family: Segoe UI Emoji, Segoe UI, Arial

svg.text: Leave objects unpublished, and disable risky tools (delete / create) in production.

text.font-family: Segoe UI Emoji, Segoe UI, Arial

svg.text: Views for JOINs, custom tools for key ops
read_records is single-entity — wrap complexity in a view; promote the procs agents should call by name to mcp.custom-tool (the rest ride execute_entity).

text.font-family: Segoe UI Emoji, Segoe UI, Arial

svg.text: Connect with Entra / managed identity (no secrets); enforce RLS in SQL — it holds no matter which tool calls.

text.font-family: Segoe UI Emoji, Segoe UI, Arial

svg.text: Enable OpenTelemetry tracing across MCP + REST + GraphQL, and set query timeouts on aggregations.

text.font-family: Segoe UI Emoji, Segoe UI, Arial

svg.text: 🏆 One config, three surfaces, governed tools — deterministic, parameterized T-SQL every time.
